items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I got to make some records with her. ... through the graces of you and MR. Eddie Mallory and Tyre and Benny Carter.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. But Ethel was a great -- I remember she was singing 'Supper Time'.
I'm lucky to be able to say that through the graces of you and MR. Eddie Mallory and Tyre and Benny Carter. I got to make some records with her.
